title: DVBench: End-to-End Benchmark for Real-World UVM Design Verification Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.25066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Design verification (DV) remains a major bottleneck in hardware development, with large-scale verification using the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) being highly labor-intensive. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems offer new opportunities for DV automation. However, existing benchmarks primarily construct mutually decoupled subtasks, which deviates from the real-world workflow. In this paper, we present DVBench, the first end-to-end benchmark for Real-World UVM design verification agents. DVBench comprises 95 tasks across 9 functional domains and 5 difficulty levels, covering diverse verification scenarios and design scales. Each task requires agents to independently complete the full verification workflow. tldr: 本文提出了首个面向真实世界UVM设计验证智能体的端到端基准测试DVBench，包含涵盖9个功能领域和5个难度级别的95个任务，要求智能体独立完成完整的验证工作流程，并通过编译、覆盖率和错误检测等多个维度综合评估。
